content.user_title: Narrow Your Content Niche With Clear Tradeoffs
content.value_statement: Scattered content makes it difficult to describe your focus and intended audience. This skill compares niche options using published posts, sustainable writing ideas, and explicit tradeoffs.
actual_capabilities: Group supplied published posts by recurring subjects rather than stated intentions.
Compare narrower positions by subject, audience, and audience stage.
Request five post titles to begin assessing whether a candidate niche could sustain fifty posts.
Identify which readers a narrower position would exclude.
Recommend roughly one deliberately chosen post outside the niche for every five posts.
When VoiceMOAT is connected, use its tools for published patterns, post response rates, and candidate niche ideas.
limitations: The writer must choose the final niche; the skill does not choose for them.
The skill does not promise account growth or validate market demand.
Analysis depends on supplied published posts or data available through a connected service.
VoiceMOAT tool access requires its connector and a Pro or Enterprise plan.

use_cases.title: Organize a creator's scattered content
use_cases.description: Group existing posts and compare sustainable niche options while keeping occasional posts outside the chosen focus.

use_cases.title: Clarify a consultant's intended audience
use_cases.description: Compare subject, audience, and stage options to describe a consulting focus and identify excluded readers.

use_cases.title: Assess a founder's writing focus
use_cases.description: Review published topics and test candidate niches with five titles before committing to a longer publishing direction.
use_cases.target_user: Founders building a public writing practice

prompt_templates.title: Identify my existing subjects
prompt_templates.prompt: Here are five published posts: [posts]. Group their actual subjects and describe my current focus without selecting a niche.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: understand the evidence in existing posts.

prompt_templates.title: Compare three narrowing options
prompt_templates.prompt: My published posts are [posts]. Compare narrowing by subject, audience, and stage, and name the readers each option excludes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: compare different ways to narrow the same content.

prompt_templates.title: Test whether a niche is sustainable
prompt_templates.prompt: My candidate niche is [niche]. Ask me for five post titles and assess repetition and research burden before discussing fifty-post sustainability.
prompt_templates.scenario: Experienced: assess writing depth before committing.

prompt_templates.title: Compare niches using connected evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: With VoiceMOAT connected, compare [niche A] and [niche B] using published patterns, response rates, idea depth, and audience tradeoffs.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: use optional connector data to support the writer's decision.

output_examples.input: Four of my six published posts discuss hiring, and two discuss pricing. I want a clearer focus.
output: Current pattern: hiring is your most frequent published subject, followed by pricing.
Subject option: hiring. Audience option: advice for agency owners. Stage option: guidance for agencies preparing to hire their first employee.
The stage option excludes established teams and readers seeking general pricing advice.
Write five titles for the option you prefer before deciding whether you can sustain it.

output_examples.input: I am considering pricing for agencies preparing to hire their first employee, but I still want to discuss other topics.
output: This candidate narrows by audience and stage while retaining pricing as the subject.
Five possible titles: Calculate your hiring budget; Price work to cover payroll; Compare employee costs; Plan for uneven revenue; Review margins before hiring.
These titles begin the sustainability test; they do not establish that fifty distinct posts are available.
Readers seeking mature agency management or general consumer pricing would fall outside this focus.
Keep roughly one deliberately chosen post outside the niche for every five posts.

best_practices: Provide representative published posts rather than relying only on what you intend to write.
Compare all three narrowing axes and choose the option you can sustain for a year.
Name excluded readers and test five distinct titles before committing to a niche.
anti_patterns: Ask the assistant to choose your niche without considering your own interests and writing capacity.
Choose a niche solely from raw engagement counts or one unusually successful post.
Treat narrowing as a guarantee of growth or prohibit every post outside the niche.

faq.question: What does this skill help me decide?
faq.answer: It helps you compare content niches by subject, audience, and stage while considering writing sustainability and excluded readers.

faq.question: Will it select a niche for me?
faq.answer: No. It presents options and tradeoffs so you can choose a focus you can sustain.

faq.question: Do I need VoiceMOAT?
faq.answer: No. You can supply published posts directly. Optional VoiceMOAT tools require its connector and a Pro or Enterprise plan.

faq.question: What is the fifty-posts test?
faq.answer: It asks whether you can write fifty distinct posts within a niche without unwanted research. Start by producing five titles.

faq.question: Will narrowing grow my account?
faq.answer: Growth is not promised. Narrowing can clarify your focus, but audience demand remains a separate market question.

faq.question: Can I publish outside my niche?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill suggests roughly one deliberately chosen post outside the niche for every five posts.
